mainTopic: Does רבי שמעון allow bringing holy food into a state where it may become disqualified (בית הפסול) from the start, or only after a mixture has already happened, as רבה claims?
overview: The גמרא tests רבה's claim that no תנא allows bringing holy food into a state where it may become disqualified (בית הפסול) from the start. רבה holds that even רבי שמעון allows it only after a mixture has already happened. אביי challenges him with a משנה that lets כהנים season קרבנות with תרומה spices, and רבה answers that spice תרומה is only דרבנן. When אביי brings a משנה about buying תרומה with מעשר שני money, רבה is silent. רב יוסף suggests a stronger source: a משנה where רבי שמעון permits cooking שביעית vegetables in תרומה oil. אביי says רבה would call this rabbinic vegetable תרומה, or would say it speaks only after the foods were already mixed. The גמרא debates whether the 'already mixed' reading fits, comparing the case to mixed animals that can graze and to mixed pieces of meat that have no fix. רבינא suggests squeezing out the oil as a fix, but רב יוסף answers that squeezing either wastes שביעית produce or does not work, so his proof stands. A new challenge then begins, from רבי שמעון's ruling about a doubtful מצורע who brings his offerings with a condition, and it continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A משנה lets כהנים add תרומה spices to קרבנות
steps.stepSummary: אביי quotes a משנה (later in our מסכת, in פרק כל התדיר, per Rashi) with רבי ישמעאל's view. It allows כהנים to cook קרבנות however they like, and even to season them with תרומה spices.
steps.simpleTranslation: The כהנים may eat all the קרבנות any way they choose: roasted, boiled, or cooked. They may also put regular spices or תרומה spices into them. These are the words of רבי ישמעאל.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי brings a משנה to challenge רבה's view that no תנא allows bringing holy food into a state where it may become disqualified from the start. רבה holds that רבי שמעון allows it only once a mixture has already happened.
steps.deeperAnalysis: תרומה normally may be eaten without a time limit. Once it is cooked into a קרבן, it has to be eaten within the קרבן's short time limit, and after that it becomes forbidden. Even so, the משנה allows it, which seems to permit bringing holy food to בית הפסול.

keyTerms.meaning: to vary the way they eat them

phrases.english: And with all of them, the priests are permitted to vary how they eat them:
to eat them roasted, boiled, or cooked,

phrases.aramaic: וְלָתֵת לְתוֹכָן תַּבְלֵי חוּלִּין וְתַבְלֵי תְרוּמָה.
phrases.english: and to put into them non-sacred spices or teruma spices.
These are the words of Rabbi Yishmael.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues an objection that began before this section, aimed at רבה's position.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבה's view that no תנא permits bringing קדשים to בית הפסול from the start (רבי שמעון only after a mixture)
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Seasoning with תרומה spices limits when the תרומה may be eaten, yet the משנה allows it.

steps.title: Spice תרומה is only rabbinic
steps.stepSummary: רבה answers that the משנה proves nothing, because תרומה on spices is only דרבנן.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: leave aside תרומה of spices, because it is only rabbinic.
steps.whatsHappening: רבה deflects the challenge. The rule against bringing holy food to בית הפסול applies to Torah-level holiness, not to rabbinic תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Spices are not one of the Torah-level crops that require תרומה, so their תרומה is only מדרבנן. The משנה's leniency therefore says nothing about real Torah-level holy food.

keyTerms.meaning: leave aside, don't bring proof from

phrases.english: He said to him: Set aside teruma of spices,
since it is rabbinic.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge from the משנה.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the scope: rabbinic holiness is different
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה permits bringing holy food to בית הפסול in general.
steps.terutzMaskana: It only permits this for rabbinic תרומה.
steps.whyThisMatters: This answer comes up again in step 5, where אביי assumes רבה would reuse it.

steps.title: Buying תרומה with מעשר שני money, and רבה is silent
steps.stepSummary: אביי brings a משנה: the תנא קמא forbids buying תרומה with מעשר שני money because it limits how the תרומה can be eaten, but רבי שמעון permits it. רבה does not answer.
steps.simpleTranslation: He objected: one may not buy תרומה with מעשר money, because that limits how it can be eaten. But רבי שמעון permits it! רבה was silent.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי brings a second challenge, this time about Torah-level תרומה, and רבה has no answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once תרומה is bought with מעשר שני money, it takes on מעשר שני limits: it must be eaten in ירושלים and an אונן may not eat it. רבי שמעון allows this anyway, so he seems to permit bringing holy food to בית הפסול. Since this is real Torah-level תרומה, the דרבנן answer does not work here.

phrases.aramaic: אֵיתִיבֵיהּ: אֵין לוֹקְחִין תְּרוּמָה בְּכֶסֶף מַעֲשֵׂר,
phrases.english: He objected to him: One may not buy teruma with tithe money,
phrases.notes: This means מעשר שני money, which must be spent on food eaten in ירושלים.

phrases.english: because he limits its eating;
and Rabbi Shimon permits it!
He was silent before him.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֵיתִיבֵיהּ אֵין לוֹקְחִין תְּרוּמָה בְּכֶסֶף מַעֲשֵׂר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge that gets around the דרבנן answer.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבה's view that רבי שמעון does not permit bringing קדשים to בית הפסול from the start
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי שמעון allows limiting Torah-level תרומה, so the issue cannot be explained away as rabbinic.
steps.whatToRemember: רבה's silence means he had no answer to this challenge.

steps.title: רב יוסף suggests a challenge from שביעית vegetables
steps.stepSummary: When אביי reports the discussion, רב יוסף asks why he didn't challenge רבה from a משנה about cooking שביעית vegetables in תרומה oil, which רבי שמעון permits.
steps.simpleTranslation: When אביי came before רב יוסף, רב יוסף said: Why didn't you challenge him from this משנה? 'One may not cook שביעית vegetables in תרומה oil, so as not to bring holy food to בית הפסול. But רבי שמעון permits it!'
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף offers another source that seems to work against רבה's position.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שביעית produce has a deadline (ביעור). If תרומה oil is cooked with it, the oil becomes tied to that deadline, which limits the תרומה. רבי שמעון permits this anyway, so he again seems to allow bringing holy food to בית הפסול.

keyTerms.meaning: vegetables grown in the שמיטה year

phrases.english: When he came before Rav Yosef,
phrases.notes: "He" is אביי, telling רב יוסף about his discussion with רבה.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אַמַּאי לָא תּוֹתְבֵיהּ מֵהָא –
phrases.english: he said to him: Why didn't you object to him from this:

phrases.aramaic: אֵין מְבַשְּׁלִין יָרָק שֶׁל שְׁבִיעִית בְּשֶׁמֶן שֶׁל תְּרוּמָה,
phrases.english: One may not cook Sabbatical-year vegetables in teruma oil,
so that they not bring holy food to a state of disqualification;
phrases.notes: "Holy food" here means the תרומה oil.

phrases.english: and Rabbi Shimon permits it!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Proposes a different source for the same challenge.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבה's view that רבי שמעון does not permit bringing קדשים to בית הפסול from the start
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי שמעון permits limiting תרומה oil by cooking it with שביעית produce.

steps.title: אביי: רבה would say this is rabbinic vegetable תרומה
steps.stepSummary: אביי explains why he did not use that source: רבה already answered him that spice תרומה is דרבנן, and he would say the same here, that the oil is rabbinic vegetable תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: Didn't I already challenge him from the spice case, and he told me, 'Leave aside spice תרומה, it is rabbinic'? Here too he would say this is vegetable תרומה, which is rabbinic.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי pushes back on רב יוסף's suggestion. He predicts רבה would escape it with the same דרבנן answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי reads the 'תרומה oil' in the משנה as oil from a crop that only needs תרומה מדרבנן. If so, the source is no stronger than the spice case.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי: וְלָאו מִי אוֹתְבִיתֵיהּ מֵהָא דְּתַבְלִין,
phrases.english: Abaye said to him: Didn't I object to him from the case of spices,

phrases.aramaic: וְאָמַר לִי: הַנַּח לִתְרוּמַת תַּבְלִין דְּרַבָּנַן?
phrases.english: and he told me: Set aside teruma of spices, which is rabbinic?
Here too, it is teruma of vegetables, which is rabbinic.
phrases.notes: Some versions leave out the word in round brackets. The point is that the oil came from a vegetable crop, not from olives.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רב יוסף's proposed challenge by reusing רבה's answer from step 2.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The challenge from the שביעית משנה
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The oil could be rabbinic vegetable תרומה.

steps.title: רב יוסף: the wording shows it is real oil תרומה
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף answers: if the משנה meant vegetable תרומה, it should have said the reverse, 'תרומה vegetables in שביעית oil.' So it means Torah-level oil תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, the משנה should have taught the reverse: תרומה vegetables in שביעית oil!
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף rejects אביי's defense based on how the משנה is worded, so his challenge stands.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the rabbinic תרומה were a vegetable, the משנה would naturally call the vegetables 'תרומה.' Since it says 'oil of תרומה,' it means olive oil, which is Torah-level תרומה. So the דרבנן answer cannot work, and רבי שמעון really does seem to allow bringing holy food to בית הפסול.

keyTerms.meaning: it should have taught the reverse

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה's wording ('oil of תרומה') shows the oil is Torah-level תרומה, so the דרבנן answer cannot defend רבה here. אביי tries a different defense in the next step.

phrases.aramaic: אִי הָכִי, אִיפְּכָא מִיבַּעְיָא לֵיהּ לְמִיתְנֵי:
phrases.english: If so, it should have taught the reverse:
phrases.notes: This is רב יוסף answering אביי.

phrases.aramaic: יָרָק שֶׁל תְּרוּמָה בְּשֶׁמֶן שֶׁל שְׁבִיעִית!
phrases.english: vegetables of teruma in Sabbatical-year oil!

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי הָכִי אִיפְּכָא מִיבַּעְיָא לֵיהּ לְמִיתְנֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects אביי's rejection, which brings back the challenge of step 4.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: אביי's suggestion that the oil is rabbinic תרומה
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The wording of the משנה does not fit vegetable תרומה.

steps.title: אביי says the oil case could also be after the foods were mixed
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the שביעית oil משנה is no proof either, because רבה could explain it as a case where the foods were already mixed, just as he explained the אשם and שלמים משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Didn't I already challenge רבה from our משנה, where רבי שמעון permits it, and he told me it speaks of a case where they became mixed? Here too, he would say it speaks of a case where they became mixed.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי pushes back on רב יוסף's point from step 6. Even if the oil is Torah-level תרומה, רבה could still answer that the משנה is talking about a mixture that already happened.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 6, רב יוסף closed off the 'rabbinic תרומה' answer. Now אביי gives a different way out: רבי שמעון only allows it after the fact, once the oil and vegetables are already mixed, not as something you may plan to do from the start. That is exactly how רבה explained the אשם and שלמים משנה, so the same answer works here.

keyTerms.meaning: I challenged him (raised a קשיא against him)

steps.confusionAlert: 'Mixed' here does not mean anyone chose to mix things. It means the mixture already happened, so רבי שמעון is only telling us what to do now, not allowing it from the start.

phrases.english: And didn't I challenge him (רבה)
phrases.notes: אביי is telling רב יוסף about another earlier challenge to רבה, from the משנה of the mixed אשם and שלמים. It is not the step 3 case, where רבה was silent.

phrases.english: from our משנה in which רבי שמעון permits,
and he told me it speaks of where they became mixed?
phrases.notes: He means the משנה of an אשם and a שלמים animal that got mixed up together.

phrases.english: Here too, it speaks of where they became mixed.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רב יוסף's claim (step 6) that the oil משנה is a strong proof against רבה.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof from the משנה about cooking שביעית vegetables in תרומה oil.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The משנה may be talking only about after the foods were already mixed, not about permission to do it from the start.

steps.title: Why would the רבנן forbid it once it is already mixed?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: if the case is after the mixing already happened, why do the רבנן still forbid cooking them together?
steps.simpleTranslation: If they became mixed, what is the reason of the רבנן?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges אביי's new reading. If the mixture already happened, it seems strange that the רבנן would still forbid it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once the oil and vegetables are already together, forbidding them seems pointless and causes a loss. So reading the משנה as 'after the fact' makes the רבנן's position hard to understand.

keyTerms.meaning: the Rabbis (the חכמים who argue with רבי שמעון)

phrases.english: If they became mixed,
what is the reason of the רבנן (for forbidding it)?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the 'already mixed' reading that אביי offered in step 7.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's reading that the oil משנה speaks after a mixture already happened.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the mixture is already done, there is no clear reason for the רבנן to forbid cooking them together.

steps.title: Same as the mixed אשם and שלמים
steps.stepSummary: The answer: the רבנן forbid it here just as they forbid it with a mixed אשם and שלמים, where even after the mixing you may not shorten the time the שלמים can be eaten.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is just like the case of an אשם and a שלמים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by pointing to the mixed-animals case, where the רבנן also forbid it even after the mixing.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With a mixed אשם and שלמים, the רבנן do not let you eat both by the stricter אשם rules, because that would cut down the eating time of the שלמים. The answer says the רבנן's reason for the oil works the same way.

keyTerms.meaning: guilt offering (stricter, eaten for one day)

phrases.english: It is just like an אשם and a שלמים (that got mixed).
phrases.notes: There, the רבנן forbid eating both by the stricter אשם rules, even after the mixing.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: Once foods are mixed, the רבנן have no reason to forbid cooking them together.
steps.terutzMaskana: The רבנן forbid it even after the mixing, just as they do with a mixed אשם and שלמים.

steps.title: The comparison fails: animals can graze, oil cannot
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the comparison. Mixed animals can be left to graze until they get a blemish, but mixed oil and vegetables have no such fix. They are really like a piece of meat mixed among other pieces, where everyone eats everything by the stricter rules.
steps.simpleTranslation: Are they comparable?! There, the אשם has a fix by letting it graze. This has no fix by grazing! This is only comparable to a piece mixed among pieces, where, since there is no fix, one eats it according to the stricter of them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the answer of step 9 and says the oil case is a totally different kind of case from the animals.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With mixed animals, the רבנן can afford to forbid the stricter eating rules, because the animals can graze until they get a blemish and then be redeemed, so nothing is lost. Oil and vegetables cannot be fixed that way, so forbidding them would waste the תרומה. The better comparison is a piece of קדשי קדשים meat mixed with pieces of קדשים קלים, where even the רבנן agree you eat everything by the stricter rules. So the רבנן should allow it here too.

keyTerms.meaning: a fix, a way to solve the problem
grazing, leaving the animal until it gets a blemish
a piece mixed among other pieces

steps.whatToRemember: Whether a mixture has a 'fix' is the key. Animals can graze until they get a blemish, so the רבנן can forbid them. Pieces of meat, or oil and vegetables, have no fix, so you eat them by the stricter rules. That makes אביי's 'already mixed' reading hard to explain for the רבנן.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets a general rule for mixtures of holy foods: if there is a way to fix the problem, use it; if not, eat everything by the stricter rules rather than waste it.

phrases.english: Are they comparable?!
There, the אשם
has a fix through grazing;
phrases.notes: The animals are left to graze until they get a blemish, and then they can be redeemed.

phrases.english: this (the oil and vegetables) has no fix through grazing!
This is only comparable
to a piece mixed among pieces,
phrases.notes: From the same משנה: a piece of קדשי קדשים meat mixed with pieces of קדשים קלים.

phrases.english: where, since there is no fix,
one eats it according to the stricter of them.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִי דָּמֵי הָתָם אָשָׁם אִית לֵיהּ תַּקַּנְתָּא בִּרְעִיָּיה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the comparison made in step 9.
steps.kashyaTarget: The comparison of the mixed oil and vegetables to a mixed אשם and שלמים.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The animals have a fix (grazing) and the oil does not. Cases with no fix follow the 'piece among pieces' rule, where even the רבנן allow eating by the stricter rules. So the רבנן should not forbid the oil and vegetables after they are mixed.

steps.title: רבינא: Oil and vegetables can be fixed by squeezing
steps.stepSummary: רבינא rejects the comparison to a piece of meat among other pieces. That case has no fix at all, but oil soaked into vegetables can be squeezed out.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא challenges this: Are these cases really alike? A piece of meat mixed among other pieces has no fix at all. But this case (oil in vegetables) does have a fix: you can squeeze the oil out!
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא pushes back against the last step's claim that oil mixed into vegetables is like a piece of meat lost among other pieces. He says the oil can be squeezed out, so there is a fix.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 10 said the oil case has no fix, so it cannot be like the mixed אשם and שלמים. רבינא says it does have a fix, squeezing, which makes it like the animals after all. That means רבה's reading, that the משנה is talking about after the mixing, can stand.

keyTerms.meaning: He challenges it; a strong objection to what was just said
A piece of meat mixed in among other pieces
A fix; a way to repair the situation
Squeezing (here, squeezing the oil out of the vegetables)

phrases.english: Ravina challenges it:
Are they comparable?!
A piece among other pieces –
has no fix at all;
this one has a fix through squeezing!
phrases.notes: He means you can squeeze the תרומה oil back out of the שביעית vegetables.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects step 10's claim that the oil and vegetable mixture has no fix.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The comparison of oil in vegetables to a piece of meat among other pieces.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The oil case does have a fix (squeezing), so it is really like the mixed אשם and שלמים, not like a lost piece of meat.

steps.title: רב יוסף: Squeezing is no real fix
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains how רב יוסף would answer: squeezing does not work. Squeezing hard wastes שביעית produce, and squeezing lightly leaves the oil still mixed in.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב יוסף, how would he respond? How exactly would you squeeze? If you squeeze a lot, you ruin the שביעית vegetables. If you squeeze a little, in the end the oil is still mixed in.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives רב יוסף's answer to רבינא: squeezing is not a real fix at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both ways of squeezing fail. Squeezing hard destroys שביעית produce, which you may not waste, and squeezing gently does not get the oil out. So there is no fix, the oil case is not like the mixed animals, and רב יוסף's proof that רבי שמעון allows this from the start still stands.

keyTerms.meaning: Causes loss or waste of שביעית produce
In the end; after all is said and done

phrases.english: And Rav Yosef [would say]: how would one squeeze?
If one squeezes a lot –
he causes a loss of שביעית produce;
if one squeezes a little –
in the end, it is still mixed.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defends רב יוסף's position against רבינא's challenge in step 11.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Denies the proposed fix works in practice
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Squeezing out the oil is a real fix, so the case is like the mixed אשם and שלמים, and רבה's reading holds.
steps.terutzMaskana: Squeezing either wastes שביעית produce or fails to remove the oil, so there is no fix. The משנה must be talking about before the mixing, which supports רב יוסף.
steps.whatToRemember: The fight over the שביעית oil משנה ends with רב יוסף's side holding: the oil case has no real fix, so the רבנן's ban only makes sense before mixing, meaning רבי שמעון allows it from the start.

steps.title: New objection: רבי שמעון's doubtful מצורע brings his offering on condition
steps.stepSummary: A new objection to רבה begins. It quotes רבי שמעון: on the next day the person brings his אשם and לוג of oil and says a condition, 'If I am a מצורע, this is my אשם and this is my לוג.' The quote continues past this point.
steps.simpleTranslation: He raised an objection: רבי שמעון says, on the next day he brings his אשם and his לוג of oil with it, and says: 'If I am a מצורע, this is my אשם and this is my לוג...'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up a new challenge against רבה by starting to quote a ברייתא with רבי שמעון's view. The full quote and the point of the attack come next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This opens a new proof, separate from the שביעית oil debate. The case is a person unsure whether he is a real מצורע, who brings his offerings with a condition. The rest of the condition, still to come, will show whether רבי שמעון allows bringing קדשים into a situation where they may become unfit from the start.

keyTerms.meaning: His לוג, the measure of oil a מצורע brings
A person with צרעת who must bring offerings to become pure

phrases.english: He raised an objection to him:
phrases.notes: This is a new attack on רבה, now quoting a ברייתא.

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says:
On the next day he brings his guilt offering
and his log of oil with it,
and he says:
If it is of a leper –
phrases.notes: He isn't sure he is a real מצורע, so he sets a condition. The other side of the condition comes right after this.

phrases.english: this is his guilt offering and this is his log,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the שביעית oil debate ends, a new source is brought to challenge רבה.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבה's view that רבי שמעון allows causing קדשים to become unfit only after the fact, not from the start.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The ברייתא about the doubtful מצורע, once fully quoted, will show רבי שמעון letting someone set up a situation from the start where קדשים may end up unfit.
